pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries within 60 seconds of an initial fill or when unrealized loss expansion exceeds 0.2% of capital.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorization during the first 15 minutes of major New York and London session intervals unless volume profile exceeds the 20-period moving average by 150%.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instant partial scaling execution when floating profit crosses +$5.00 to prevent evaporation into breakeven or stop-outs.
